description: Each property type maps to its column type, default and constraint

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sample` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `label` text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `count` integer DEFAULT 0,
  `ratio` real,
  `done` integer DEFAULT 0,
  `due` integer,
  `meta` text,
  `items` text,
  `ref` blob,
  `blob` blob,
  `size` text DEFAULT 'm',
  `code` text,
  CONSTRAINT `sample_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `sample_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `sample_owner_index` ON `sample` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `sample_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `sample`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `sample`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `sample_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`label` AS `label`,
  `t`.`count` AS `count`,
  `t`.`ratio` AS `ratio`,
  `t`.`done` AS `done`,
  `t`.`due` AS `due`,
  `t`.`meta` AS `meta`,
  `t`.`items` AS `items`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`ref` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`ref`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`ref`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`ref`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`ref`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`ref`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `ref`,
  `t`.`blob` AS `blob`,
  `t`.`size` AS `size`,
  `t`.`code` AS `code`
FROM `sample` AS `t`
